info.prompt: A high-angle shot reveals the full glory of the bio-mechanical gaming altar—its skeletal gold framework supporting pulsing neural conduits that branch like a nervous system across the Void Black expanse. At the center, five perfect hits have triggered the Combo Frenzy: the entire structure convulses as Electric Magenta waves ripple outward from the impact point. Translucent tiles shatter in sequence, each explosion revealing scoring multipliers that hang suspended in the charged air while hacker text waterfalls vertically along the gothic arch supports.
